body:
Phase 3 (closing audit) of design #3068 — "parsed is not validated: one shape contract at every JSON trust boundary" (design doc: `files/designs/code-parsed-is-not-validated.md` in the keep-the-four-repos-healthy goal workspace). Filed by design-architect pass 26 (2026-10-31); **gated on Phases 1–2 of #3068 landing** (Phase 1: #2938, #2816, #2821, #2974; Phase 2: #2832, #2738, #2800, #2827, #2618). The adopted frame origins of this phase — #2824 and #2802 (id web collab/world frame shape) — are NOT gated on Phases 1–2 and proceed on their own triage; this issue is only the audit + contract statement.

## Scope

Inventory every parse-then-dereference boundary in the surfaces #3068 covers — `bin/`, `scripts/`, `pkgs/` tools (incl. cold-store-reaper and t3code-seed-providers), pm-stack's non-aggregator handlers, and `pkgs/id/web` — i.e. every `JSON.parse`, `response.json()`, `json.loads`, and MessagePack decode whose result is dereferenced. For each hit, disposition it in the closing evidence:

- (a) covered by #3068 Phases 1–3 (name the origin issue), or
- (b) a boundary the phases missed and the same rule covers — fix it under this issue if small and same-rule, otherwise file it as a named follow-up and link it here, or
- (c) not a trust boundary (code-constructed input, or shape already validated at the deref level) — named, with the one-line reason.

## Explicit dispositions required

- **#2608** (cloudflare-export: GraphQL `errors` assumed to be an array of `{message: string}`): decide its ownership once — it sits in a pm-stack exporter that #2576's Phase 3 also touches. Record here (and on #2608) whether it is fixed under #2576's Phase 3 as-built scope or under this design's rule; do not double-file it.
- Every `?? []` / `|| {}` / `?? {}` default at a parse boundary in the inventory: disposition as optional-by-design (the deref site treats absence and emptiness identically on purpose) or absence-as-emptiness (corollary 3 of #3068 — a bug; fix or follow-up per (b)).

## Contract statement

Write the #3068 rule where this repo already states such contracts (bin header docs; the aggregator README's contract section by reference, without reopening #2576's document scope), in the terms the design doc records: validate the shape you deref, at the boundary, before any side effect; exact plain-object vocabulary; failure is the surface's own error; absence is not emptiness; the shared probe matrix (`null`, array, scalar, `{}`, each relied-on field wrong-typed).

## Acceptance

- [ ] Inventory evidence posted on this issue (or a linked PR): every parse-then-deref boundary in the scoped surfaces with a disposition (a)/(b)/(c)
- [ ] #2608's ownership decided and recorded on both this issue and #2608
- [ ] Any (b) follow-ups filed and linked; any small same-rule fixes landed
- [ ] Contract statement landed; design issue #3068 closed with a link to this evidence
- [ ] This phase did not start before #3068 Phases 1–2 landed (record their closing state in the evidence)
